notes.title: Update
notes.content: Version alpha 0.5, what's new: the game location has been changed,the main character has been changed, some mechanics and animations have been reworked, a new menu has been added, graphics settings have been added

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Game Update alpha version 0.3 :
- Changed the lighting in the game.
- Expanded and changed the game map (added mountains, trees).
- Added new game objects.

COMING SOON in the next update:
Completely change the model of the game character and weapons, change the weather, as well as day and night, new story tasks will be added, and perhaps a cooperative mode will appear
